name: Albino Red Xenomorph
prompt:

Image 1: anatomy/rendering reference ONLY from its TOP ROW red organic Warrior; ignore all yellow and robotic lower rows. Create ONE newly authored Albino Red Xenomorph in standing alert idle stance. PROJECT_ADAPTATION systemic albino derivative of the reviewed V66 enemy-019-red-xenomorph identity only. Preserve one adult rival-hive Red-caste Warrior: long ridged eyeless dome, double jaw, narrow ribbed torso, lean waist, exactly two long clawed arms, two digitigrade legs, four dorsal tubes and exactly one complete segmented spear-tipped tail. Red denotes the Genocide hive lineage, not a required red coat: albino changes pigment and material response only to warm pearl-ivory and pale bone carapace, cool ash-gray biomechanical recesses, restrained translucent rose-taupe soft tissue, dark desaturated cavities, wet highlights and metallic ivory/silver teeth; no saturated vermilion shell, flat pure white, glow or automatic recolor. Do not inherit numeric sourceScaleByClip values, the historical final-pack scale or legacy bounds-center-bottom roots: the base has no completed measured scaleCalibrationReview, no retained scaleCalibrationEvidence and no reviewed anchor-registry entry. Do not reproduce the base move sheet's cross-cell boundary contacts or its weak locomotion/attack weight transfer. No Queen crown, Red King bulk, Prowler quadruped, yellow K-Series coat, equipment, extra limb or copied comic composition. Every future pixel must be original fan-made/project art; canonExact=false and no 1:1 claim.
The species lineage is Red-caste but this new material variant is pale ivory. Keep two separately visible claw hands, two feet, exactly four organic dorsal tubes, ridged skull and full continuous spear-tipped tail. ONE whole creature, strict orthographic RIGHT-facing profile; tail behind left. True transparent alpha, no floor/shadow/halo. Entire silhouette inside central 75% canvas, with 10%+ empty transparent margins on every side. No sheet, grid, duplicates, text, logos, watermark, robotic machinery, props, gore or cropping. Single static pose only.
